Macklemore removed from Ed Sheeran tour after Palestine comments

Rapper Macklemore has been removed from the remaining US dates of Ed Sheeran's "Mathematics Tour" following his on-stage "free Palestine" statement. The decision was reportedly made after his remarks at the MetLife Stadium show. Singer Pink also shared a statement addressing criticism she received for a post that reportedly criticized Macklemore's speech.
